snippet.title: SKINFACE Demo Version 2.0 Release Trailer (2026)
snippet.description:
SKINFACE has a new demo with more content out now on Steam. 

Link:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4475540/SKINFACE_Demo

Please consider adding the game to your wishlist if you like what you see. We are running an experiment, if the game gets 10K wishlists, we'll expand the game into a full release.
